item.title: Activity in Bitcoin account from ransom email; less than $300 in activity
item.description: KGUN 9 can confirm there is activity in the bitcoin account listed in the ransom email. The activity is less than $300.

item.title: Oro Valley Police confirm members from SWAT activated to work with Pima County Sheriff's Department on mission
item.description: Oro Valley Police officials have confirmed members of the regional SWAT team and bomb squads have been activated for a mission with the Pima County Sheriff's Department as the point of contact.

item.title: Person detained in connection to Nancy Guthrie case, ABC News reports
item.description: The Pima County Sheriff’s Department, with assistance from the FBI, has detained an individual for questioning in connection with the abduction of Nancy Guthrie.
